merger_name: Australian Venue Co – assets of The Clock Hotel, Surry Hills and The Bank Hotel, Newtown, NSW
merger_description:
AVC Operations Pty Ltd (**AVC**) proposes to acquire substantially all of the assets (including the exclusive right to carry on the businesses in succession of the vendor) of two licensed hospitality businesses in New South Wales, being the acquisition of substantially all of the assets of the businesses trading as The Clock Hotel and The Bank Hotel, pursuant to an asset sale agreement, with certain assets excluded from the sale (the **Acquisition**).

AVC is a subsidiary of Australian Venue Co Holdings Limited which operates over 200 licensed venues throughout Australia and New Zealand, primarily pubs, as well as some bars, clubs and licensed restaurants. AVC's venues are individually branded and are mostly located in inner-city and metropolitan areas, offering a range of products and services including food, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, function rooms, live entertainment and gaming facilities.

The Clock Hotel is a pub with a rooftop and courtyard, located at 470-474 Crown Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010. The Bank Hotel is a pub with a beer garden and live music offering, located at 324 King Street, Newtown NSW 2042.

The Clock Hotel and The Bank Hotel are currently owned and operated by Amalgamated Hotels Pty Limited.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver and had regard
to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition, given:
a. the increase in Australian Venue Co’s share of supply of
dining, function and on-premises liquor services at pub-style
venues in the local area surrounding The Clock Hotel and
The Bank Hotel is estimated to be small
b. there are alternative pub-style venues which supply dining,
function and on-premises liquor services in the local areas
surrounding The Clock Hotel and The Bank Hotel
respectively.
